Plymouth's manager responded by introducing fresh legs, bringing on Matthew Sorinola and Julio Pleguezuelo to regain control of the flanks and revitalize an attack that was struggling to find a clinical edge. The game reached a turning point in the 87th minute when Ethan Sutherland , who had been cautioned only nine minutes earlier, committed a tactical foul that resulted in a second yellow card. His dismissal left Exeter City a man down for the closing stages, forcing them into a defensive shell as Plymouth Argyle launched a final, desperate assault on the Grecians' goal. Stoppage Time Fireworks Just as the match seemed destined for a penalty shootout, the deadlock was finally broken in the 92nd minute. A pinpoint corner from Harvey White found the head of Alex Hartridge , who powered his effort into the top left corner from close range. The breakthrough sent the home supporters into a frenzy, but the drama was far from over as the clock ticked deep into added time. With Exeter pushing everyone forward in search of an equalizer, Plymouth Argyle struck again in the 94th minute. Freddie Issaka spearheaded a lightning-fast counter-attack, squaring the ball to Aribim Pepple in the center of the box. Pepple made no mistake, slotting the ball home to secure a 2-0 victory. Although Josh Gordon forced one final save from Murphy Cooper in the dying seconds, the result was already sealed, sending Plymouth through to the next round.
